topic.name: 光、事件与时钟
topic.title: 同一次实验，为什么时间不同？
topic.question: 同一次实验，为什么时间不同？
topic.description: 从列车闪光、μ子存活和四台飞行钟，看参考系与固有时间怎样接受检验。

zh: 相对论怎样接受实验检验？
同一次实验，为什么时间不同？

translations.从转动干涉仪到μ子计数和飞行原子钟，比较可以观察的差异。: Compare observable differences in rotating interferometers, muon counts and flying clocks.
translations.两种算法使用相同的100个指数分位，不是真实随机样本。: Both calculations use the same 100 exponential quantiles, not a random experimental sample.
translations.历史表格不随控件变化；钟差已做速率变化分析。: Historical tables do not change with controls; clock offsets include rate-change analysis.
translations.往返光路与固定实验记录: Returning light paths and fixed experimental records
translations.以太风条纹来自经典模型；零结果为示意，不是历史噪声数据。: The ether fringes come from a classical model; the null panel is illustrative, not historical noise data.
translations.标注的是墙壁处的到达事件坐标，不是远处观察者收到消息的时刻。: Times label events at the walls, not the later receipt of a message by a distant observer.
translations.从列车闪光、μ子存活和四台飞行钟，看参考系与固有时间怎样接受检验。: Follow train flashes, muon survivors and four flying clocks to test reference frames and proper time.

cues.title: 先算出可以被检验的预期
cues.caption: 转动仪器，检验以太风的预言。
cues.captionEn: Rotate to test the ether-wind prediction.
cues.zh: 光在分束片分成两路，分别沿互相垂直的臂往返，再合并到探测端。假如地球穿过静止以太，沿风和横风的往返时间应不同。转动仪器，假设模型预期条纹会移动。上栏条纹由这个历史假设的往返时间计算，不能当成真实观察结果。
cues.en: A beam splitter sends light along perpendicular arms and recombines the returning beams. A stationary-ether hypothesis predicts different round-trip times along and across Earth’s motion. Rotating the apparatus should move the fringes. The upper strip calculates that historical hypothesis, not an actual observation.

cues.title: 把预期与实验结果比较
cues.titleEn: Compare the expectation with the result
cues.caption: 条纹没有按预期移动。
cues.captionEn: The fringes did not shift as predicted.
cues.zh: 迈克耳孙和莫雷没有观察到预期大小的条纹变化。下栏用理想不移动条纹示意这个零结果，不伪造原始噪声或误差条。它对当时的解释构成重要约束，但不能单凭一幅理想图就推导出完整相对论。光程取十一米的等效单臂长度，图形折叠被简化。
cues.en: Michelson and Morley did not observe the expected fringe change. The lower stationary strip illustrates an ideal null result without inventing historical noise or error bars. It constrained contemporary explanations, but one ideal image does not derive all of relativity. Each effective arm is eleven metres; optical folding is simplified.

cues.title: 同一次闪光，两次到壁
cues.caption: 比较的是光到壁的事件。
cues.captionEn: Compare the events where light meets each wall.
cues.zh: 车厢中央发出同一次闪光。先跟着车厢看：两边路程相等，光速相同，两壁同时亮起。换到地面看，列车向右运动，后壁迎向光，前壁却在远离光。光仍然以同样的速度传播，于是先到后壁，后到前壁。注意，比较的是光与墙壁相遇的两个事件，不是某个人后来收到消息的时刻。
cues.en: A single flash leaves the middle of the carriage. In the train frame, equal distances and equal light speeds give simultaneous arrivals at the two walls. In the ground frame, the train moves right. The rear wall approaches its light pulse while the front wall moves away. Light still travels at the same speed, so it reaches the rear wall first. These are wall-arrival events, not the times when a distant observer receives their messages.

cues.title: 同一事件，换一个参考系
cues.caption: 换参考系，不换那两个事件。
cues.captionEn: Change the frame, not the two events.
cues.zh: 保留两个到壁标记，只换坐标。这个归一化例子中，地面记录的到达时刻是零点二五和一；车厢记录却都是零点五。不是改了实验，而是不同参考系的同时不再相同。现在先猜：列车向左开，地面上哪一端先到光？右端成了后壁，所以先亮。最后让车静止，两路重新同时到达。
cues.en: Keep both arrival-event labels and change coordinates. In this normalized example, ground times are zero point two five and one. The train assigns zero point five to both. We have not changed the experiment: different frames disagree about simultaneity. Now predict what happens if the train moves left. The right wall becomes the rear wall and lights first. With the train stationary, both arrivals are simultaneous again.

cues.title: 相同粒子群，两种存活预言
cues.caption: 寿命相同，代入的时间不同。
cues.zh: 先看真实记录。弗里施和史密斯在山顶与海平面多次计数，平均每小时五百六十三和四百零八；这不是逐个跟踪同一批粒子。现在另建一百个粒子的教学对照：同样的初始身份、速度和路程。经典算法让衰变经历全部地面时间，相对论则使用更短的固有时间。到达地面时，经典对照几乎全无，相对论还留下约一成。变的是经历的时间，平均固有寿命并没有变长。
cues.en: First, actual records. Frisch and Smith measured average rates of five hundred sixty-three per hour on the mountain and four hundred eight at sea level. They did not track individual particles between stations. Now use a separate teaching population of one hundred, with identical starting identities, speed and distance. The classical calculation uses the full ground time for decay. Relativity uses the shorter proper time. At arrival, the classical population is practically gone, while about one tenth survives relativistically. The proper mean lifetime itself has not changed.

cues.title: 为什么是固有时间
cues.caption: 换参考系，幸存的身份不变。
cues.captionEn: A change of frame preserves the survivors.
cues.zh: 用光钟作类比：跟着钟看，光上下走；在地面看，钟向前运动，光走更长的斜线。光速相同，因此同一拍对应更长的地面时间。这不是说μ子内部真的有两面镜子。回到μ子自身参考系，地面迎面而来，路程缩短，算出的固有时间和幸存身份完全相同。再预测：路程不变，速度从零点九九倍光速增加到零点九九五倍，会剩下更多吗？固有时间进一步缩短，这组教学粒子由十一颗增加到二十二颗。
cues.en: A light clock illustrates the geometry. With the clock, light travels vertically. From the ground, the moving clock makes that path diagonal and longer. With the same light speed, one tick takes more ground time. This is an analogy, not mirrors inside a muon. In the muon frame, the ground approaches over a contracted distance, giving the same proper time and survivors. Predict a faster trip over the same distance: increase the speed from zero point nine nine to zero point nine nine five times light speed. Less proper time passes, and this teaching population leaves twenty-two survivors instead of eleven.

cues.title: 东行：两种效应竞争
cues.caption: 速度与高度，共同决定钟差。
cues.zh: 一九七一年，同一组四台铯原子钟先向东环球飞行，再与美国海军天文台的基准比较。要解释钟差，先看不随地球自转的参考系：东行把飞机速度加到地面自转速度上，运动项让飞行钟少走一些；较高的引力势却让它多走一些。按实际航线计算，预言净差约负四十纳秒。揭开四台钟经速率变化分析后的记录：平均负五十九纳秒，在报告的不确定度内与预言相容。
cues.en: In nineteen seventy-one, the same four cesium clocks first flew east around the world and were compared with the US Naval Observatory reference. In a frame that does not rotate with Earth, eastward flight adds to the ground speed. Motion reduces elapsed time, while greater gravitational potential adds time. Using the actual route, the published prediction was about minus forty nanoseconds. Now reveal the four clock offsets after rate-change analysis: their reported mean was minus fifty-nine nanoseconds, compatible with the prediction within the stated uncertainties.

cues.title: 西行与新条件的检验
cues.caption: 换向改变运动项，不反转高度项。
cues.captionEn: Reversal changes motion, not the height effect.
cues.zh: 随后仍是这四台钟，改向西环球飞行。先别揭答案：飞机速度抵消了一部分地面自转速度，运动项会怎样？它转为增加时间，高度项也仍是正的。实际航线预言约正二百七十五纳秒，记录的平均值是正二百七十三纳秒。最后换成明确的恒高教学模型：若只把高度降到零，高度项消失，东西方向的运动差别仍在。真实记录不会跟着滑块改变，东行也不是任何条件下都必然少走。
cues.en: The same four clocks later flew west. Before revealing the result, predict the motion term. Westward speed cancels part of Earth’s surface speed, so it adds elapsed time; the height term remains positive. The actual-route prediction was about plus two hundred seventy-five nanoseconds, and the reported mean was plus two hundred seventy-three. Finally, use a clearly labeled constant-height teaching model. Lowering only the height to zero removes that contribution, while the east–west motion difference remains. Sliders never change the historical records, and eastward flight does not always mean a time loss.
